messages.subject: Making a simple map
parts:
Hi,
I am very new to R and ggplot. I have a csv file that has 3 columns (longitude, latitude and temperature). This is station/point data. I want to temperature at each point give, on the map (Africa). What is the easiest way to do this?

Thanks in advance

Regards
Mokoena
